items.q: How many valence electrons do Group 1 elements have?
items.explain: Group 1 elements have one valence electron.

items.q: Which group contains the noble gases?
items.explain: The noble gases are in Group 18 and have full outer shells.
items.explainAf: Die edelgasse is in Groep 18 en het volle buitenste skille.

items.q: An element has the electron arrangement 2; 8; 7. In which group is it?
items.qAf: ’n Element het die elektronrangskikking 2; 8; 7. In watter groep is dit?
items.explain: Seven valence electrons means the element is in Group 17 (the halogens).
items.explainAf: Sewe valenselektrone beteken dat die element in Groep 17 (die halogene) is.

items.q: Moving from left to right across a period, the atomic radius:
items.qAf: Wanneer ’n mens van links na regs oor ’n periode beweeg, die atoomradius:
items.explain: More protons pull the electrons closer, so the atomic radius decreases.
items.explainAf: Meer protone trek die elektrone nader, dus neem die atoomradius af.

items.q: Which Group 1 metal is more reactive than sodium?
items.qAf: Watter Groep 1-metaal is meer reaktief as natrium?
items.explain: Reactivity increases down Group 1, so potassium is more reactive than sodium.
items.explainAf: Reaktiwiteit neem af Groep 1 toe, dus is kalium meer reaktief as natrium.

items.q: Element X is a shiny solid that conducts electricity. Where is it most likely found on the table?
items.qAf: Element X is ’n blink vaste stof wat elektrisiteit gelei. Waar op die tabel is dit waarskynlik?
options: Metals on the left and in the centre
Noble gases on the far right
optionsAf: Metale aan die linkerkant en in die middel
items.explain: Shiny, conducting solids are metals, which are found on the left and in the centre.
items.explainAf: Blink, geleidende vastestowwe is metale, wat aan die linkerkant en in die middel voorkom.

items.q: The measure of the tendency of an atom to attract a bonding pair of electrons.
items.qAf: Die maatstaf van die neiging van ’n atoom om ’n bindingselektronpaar aan te trek.

items.q: Half the distance between the nuclei of two bonded atoms of the same element.
items.qAf: Die helfte van die afstand tussen die kerne van twee gebonde atome van dieselfde element.

items.text: Across a period from left to right, atomic radius [[]] and ionisation energy [[]].
items.textAf: Oor ’n periode van links na regs [[]] atoomradius en ionisasie-energie [[]].

items.q: Fluorine is the most electronegative element.
items.qAf: Fluoor is die mees elektronegatiewe element.
items.explain: True. Its electronegativity is 4,0 on the Pauling scale.
items.explainAf: Waar. Sy elektronegatiwiteit is 4,0 op die Pauling-skaal.

items.q: Reactivity of the alkali metals decreases down the group.
items.qAf: Die reaktiwiteit van die alkalimetale neem af in die groep af.
items.explain: False. It increases: the outer electron is further from the nucleus and is lost more easily.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Dit neem toe: die buitenste elektron is verder van die kern en word makliker verloor.

items.q: Explain why the first ionisation energy decreases down Group 1.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die eerste ionisasie-energie in Groep 1 af daal.
points: Down the group the atoms have more energy levels, so the outer electron is further from the nucleus.
Inner electrons shield it, so the attraction of the nucleus is weaker and less energy is needed to remove it.
pointsAf: In die groep af het die atome meer energievlakke, dus is die buitenste elektron verder van die kern.
Binneste elektrone skerm dit af, dus is die aantrekking van die kern swakker en minder energie is nodig om dit te verwyder.
